summary: The Iowa Conservation Commission's Planning Section reviewed the draft environmental statement and found it to be a complete and concise document that addresses environmental, social, and economic issues. They also confirmed they would make copies of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle Report available to the public. Their overall tone is positive and appreciative, with no substantive objections raised.

statement.text:
Dear Mr. Hofe:
Our Planning Section has just reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644 pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on public lands. They report this to be a complete and concise statement dealing not only with the environmental, but also social, and economic issues as well.
As you have requested, copies of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle Report will be made available to the public for review in this office.
We appreciate your cooperation in allowing us to review this document.
Sincerely,
Fred A. Priewert, Director Iowa Conservation Commission
